nodes.rationale: Temporal payloads are capped at 2MB; heavy BaseNode/entity lists exceed it, so state is pickled to MinIO and only a small URI ticket travels between activities.

nodes.label: Task queue isolation / head-of-line blocking
nodes.rationale: Separate lanes (kb-ingest-llm vs kb-ingest-merge) stop an extract_kg flood from starving a document's merge that sits behind it in one FIFO.

nodes.label: LLMPool concurrency gating
nodes.rationale: Two-level lane-then-tier gate above Temporal caps; deliberate over-subscription lets one workload fill the GPU while judge_floor keeps merge/judge from starving.

nodes.label: Deterministic identifier canonicalization
nodes.rationale: Canonical string computed by checksum-validated code, seeded into the graph, AND fed to the LLM as required spelling — three forces collapse every variant onto one node deterministically, before the LLM sees the chunk.

nodes.label: Community detection / Leiden
nodes.rationale: Leiden chosen over Louvain for its guarantee of internally well-connected communities plus a built-in hierarchical dendrogram.

nodes.label: Native-vector kNN ER candidate source
nodes.rationale: The 5000-entity window reaches only ~2% of true nearest canonicals at 200k scale; per-entity Neo4j vector kNN over the whole graph recovers ~96% at ~6ms/query.

nodes.label: MCP servers (MCP-1 kb_search, MCP-2 atomic tools)
nodes.norm_label: mcp servers (mcp-1 kb_search, mcp-2 atomic tools)

nodes.label: GraphBuildWorkflow (child)
nodes.rationale: Graph half is a child workflow so a slow/stuck merge gets its own retry/timeout and can be cancelled without restarting the fast vector half.

nodes.label: vector_only degradation
nodes.rationale: Graph is an enhancement, not a blocker: if the graph half raises/times out the doc stays searchable via vectors and the graph is skipped.

nodes.label: LLM_POOL_N throttle
nodes.rationale: The one binding constraint is the shared LiteLLM proxy/GPU concurrency; size N to the latency knee and keep Temporal caps generously above N so the pool binds first.

nodes.label: Link prediction (LIKELY_LINK)
nodes.rationale: Predicted edges are quarantined: a conclusion is never built on a LIKELY_LINK, only on real edges — the prediction only hints where to look.

nodes.label: Provenance-is-ground-truth rule
nodes.rationale: Numbers must be read from provenance.steps[].rows, not the synthesized LLM answer, which can paraphrase and confuse figures.

nodes.label: Traag et al. (2019) From Louvain to Leiden
nodes.norm_label: traag et al. (2019) from louvain to leiden

nodes.label: SearchOrchestratorWorkflow (local plan-execute)
nodes.rationale: thin plan→fan-out→coverage→rerank→synthesize coordinator; only LLM decisions are the planner and synthesizer, retrieval in between is deterministic (no ReAct tool-choice loop).

nodes.label: GlobalSearchWorkflow (GraphRAG map-reduce over communities)
nodes.rationale: answers corpus-level/thematic questions via MAP-REDUCE over offline community reports instead of fetching individual chunks.

nodes.label: DriftSearchWorkflow (local-then-global, bounded)
nodes.rationale: contextualize once, run one local then one global child; degrades to local answer if global fails (mode stays 'drift').

nodes.label: AutoSearchWorkflow (routed dispatch)
nodes.rationale: route_query classifies local/global/drift then dispatches child; fail-safe defaults to local on any unparseable route.

nodes.label: CommunityBuildWorkflow (offline community build on kb-graph-build)
nodes.rationale: fully decoupled/offline — never on the hot query path; detect (GDS/leidenalg Leiden) + summarize into structured reports, idempotent MERGE.

nodes.label: retrieve_subquestion — deterministic retrieval pipeline
nodes.rationale: fixed tool sequence vector_search → graph_search → find_entity_by_name → seeded graph_walk; per-tool fail-open, dual walk-seed.

nodes.label: synthesize_answer — large-tier synthesis activity
nodes.rationale: pinned to kb-search-large with a low-concurrency worker pool so the heavy synthesis model is not dogpiled by parallel sessions; shared by local/global/drift REDUCE.

nodes.label: map_communities — community selection (lexical/semantic/descent)
nodes.rationale: spends MAP budget on query-relevant communities; both vector strategies fail-open to lexical.

nodes.label: IngestSchedulerWorkflow (singleton admission control, Track 5)
nodes.rationale: admits ≤K documents at once (FIFO AdmissionState) so a document's merge tail isn't starved behind extracts of newer docs; continue_as_new bounds history.

nodes.label: vLLM (native w4a16-ct QAT inference, Path B fallback)
nodes.norm_label: vllm (native w4a16-ct qat inference, path b fallback)

nodes.label: Neo4j GDS Leiden (gds.leiden.stream)
nodes.rationale: detects communities over the __Entity__ subgraph; GDS 2.x calls not verified against a live GDS install in the dev sandbox.

nodes.label: Arc 2 — continuous monitoring + alerts (risk_score)
nodes.rationale: highest-leverage arc — turns Q&A into an intelligence system that surfaces new connections/rising risk via Temporal Schedule + dirty-mark on first_seen and risk_score.

nodes.label: Architecture Decision Records (ADR) practice
nodes.rationale: ADRs record one decision each (context/decision/consequences/rejected alternatives/references). Immutable once Accepted; a later reversing decision gets its own record and the old one is marked Superseded, so the log reads as the project's reasoning over time. Each ADR is grounded in real code, and still-latent parts are flagged explicitly.

nodes.label: kb-llamaindex RAG system
nodes.rationale: RAG system orchestrated via Temporal over a Neo4j knowledge graph, a Milvus chunk index and a local canonical Wikibase anchor.

nodes.label: CONCEPTS.md (planned educational companion)
nodes.rationale: Answers 'what is it and how does it work' (mechanism); ADRs answer 'why did we choose this over alternatives'. Until it lands, ARCHITECTURE.md/QUEUES.md/SEARCH.md/MODELS.md/INGEST.md and runbooks serve.

nodes.label: ADR-0001: Temporal for durable orchestration
nodes.rationale: Long-running ingest needs durable, retryable, replay-safe orchestration; chosen as the workflow engine for the pipeline.

nodes.label: ADR-0002: Claim-check staging via MinIO
nodes.rationale: Heavy intermediate state (KG blobs) is staged in MinIO and passed by reference so Temporal payloads stay small.

nodes.label: ADR-0003: Task-queue isolation to avoid head-of-line blocking
nodes.rationale: Separate FIFO queues per stage (kb-ingest / kb-ingest-llm / kb-ingest-merge) prevent a document's merge tail from starving behind extracts of newer documents.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003: task-queue isolation to avoid head-of-line blocking

nodes.label: ADR-0004: Per-process LLMPool owns LLM concurrency
nodes.rationale: A single per-process pool (tier-ceiling + per-role lane) owns LLM concurrency to protect the GPU; Temporal queue-caps become isolation-only.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004: per-process llmpool owns llm concurrency

nodes.label: ADR-0005: Deterministic identifier canonicalization before LLM extraction
nodes.rationale: Identifier types get a deterministic regex canonical up front so entity resolution never touches them; higher precision than LLM extraction.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0005: deterministic identifier canonicalization before llm extraction

nodes.label: ADR-0006: Milvus HNSW as default chunk index
nodes.rationale: HNSW chosen as the default chunk index for the Milvus vector store.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0006: milvus hnsw as default chunk index

nodes.label: ADR-0007: Entity Resolution = candidate-gen + LLM-judge + cache + union-find
nodes.rationale: Vector similarity alone cannot resolve cross-language/abbreviation/word-order/initial variants; combine candidate generation, LLM judge, a verdict cache and union-find. Conservative by design (DIFFERENT on timeout) because a false merge poisons the graph.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0007: entity resolution = candidate-gen + llm-judge + cache + union-find

nodes.label: ADR-0008: Optional native-vector kNN ER over 5000-row window
nodes.rationale: The 5000-entity comparison window is a ceiling on large graphs (sees ~2% of true matches at 200k); native Neo4j vector kNN over the whole graph restores recall.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0008: optional native-vector knn er over 5000-row window

nodes.label: ADR-0009: Hierarchical Leiden communities + structured reports
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical Leiden clustering with structured community reports underpins corpus-level (global/drift) search.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0009: hierarchical leiden communities + structured reports

nodes.label: ADR-0010: Dynamic community selection (lexical/semantic/descent)
nodes.rationale: Communities are selected dynamically per query via lexical/semantic/descent strategies rather than a fixed set.

nodes.label: ADR-0011: Plan-execute SearchOrchestratorWorkflow
nodes.rationale: Search runs as a plan-then-execute orchestrator workflow (decompose -> parallel retrieve -> coverage-gate -> rerank -> synthesize).

nodes.label: ADR-0012: Wikibase canonical anchor + continuous wiki editor
nodes.rationale: A self-hosted Wikibase gives a canonical anchor, and a continuous wiki editor materializes per-entity MediaWiki articles from the graph.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0012: wikibase canonical anchor + continuous wiki editor

nodes.label: ADR-0013: Multi-model role/tier selection + snapshot-at-submit
nodes.rationale: LLM role maps to a tier (small/large) -> physical model; the resolved per-role model is snapshotted at submit so env changes only affect new documents.

nodes.label: ADR-0014: Source download via stable API endpoint
nodes.rationale: Original source files are served from a stable GET /api/v1/documents/{doc_id} endpoint streaming from MinIO.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0014: source download via stable api endpoint

nodes.label: ADR-0015: Community-detection backend = in-worker leidenalg
nodes.rationale: Community detection was moved out of Neo4j GDS into an in-worker leidenalg backend.

nodes.label: Bruno API collection
nodes.rationale: Plain-text .bru files (git-friendly) covering Health, Ingestion, the four Search modes, Documents download and Admin. Legacy /api/v1/search,/agent,/selfrag,/legacy/agent were removed in the R7b cutover.

nodes.label: Bruno sample upload document (RU medical PII fixture)
nodes.rationale: Fixture text with Russian PII (patient name, INN, phone, doctor) used by the Bruno Upload Document request.
nodes.norm_label: bruno sample upload document (ru medical pii fixture)

nodes.label: kb-llamaindex conference decks (Marp)
nodes.rationale: Two Marp Markdown decks built to PDF/PPTX/HTML via marp-cli + Puppeteer/Chrome.

nodes.label: Three query endpoints: /search, /agent, /selfrag (legacy)
nodes.rationale: One question -> three answers trading latency vs reasoning vs verifiability: /search (1 call, fast), /agent (ReAct, agentic), /selfrag (reflective, citations per claim). All share the Milvus+Neo4j retrieval stack. Later removed in the R7b cutover in favour of /search/{local,global,drift,auto}.

nodes.label: 5-step ingestion pipeline
nodes.rationale: SimpleDirectoryReader -> SentenceSplitter(512/50) -> IdentifierCanonicalization -> TranslateToRussian (skip if already RU) -> Milvus vector index + best-effort Neo4j KG build. Graph step wrapped in try/except so Neo4j failure does not block vector search.

nodes.label: LightRAG-style KG extraction
nodes.rationale: One LLM call per chunk emits entities and relations together (tuple format), ~1 call/chunk vs N; drop-in TransformComponent, gleaning_passes=0 to save cost.

nodes.label: Entity Resolution 12-step pipeline
nodes.rationale: Filter identifier labels; load canonicals; embed; deterministic prepass; candidate pairs at cosine>=LOW(0.55); auto-merge at cosine>=HIGH AND same script; LLM-judge borderline; union-find; verify large clusters; hyper-hub clamp -> er_review_needed; pick canonical; rewrite chunk metadata. Conservative: DIFFERENT on timeout, cross-script always via LLM, better a duplicate than a false merge.

nodes.label: IdentifierCanonicalization ingest step
nodes.rationale: Regex canonicalization of identifier types (INN/OGRN/BIC/email/phone/... 24 types) into metadata['canonical_identifiers'] + an augment-block injected into node.text so downstream ER can skip them.

nodes.label: KG extraction fix: SchemaLLMPathExtractor -> SimpleLLMPathExtractor
nodes.rationale: SchemaLLMPathExtractor threw TypeError on malformed small-LLM JSON and small models skipped tool-calls -> 0 relations in Neo4j (caught by scripts/check_ingestion.py). Fix: SimpleLLMPathExtractor (regex, noise-tolerant) + replace English Alice/Bob/Philz prompt with a RU B2B example -> 18 entities + 9 typed relations. Lesson: RU prompt matters more than model quality on small LLMs; end-to-end diagnostics beat unit tests.

nodes.label: /agent ReAct loop (8 tools)
nodes.rationale: ReAct loop over 8 tools with an anti-loop guard (3 identical (tool,args) -> exit) for multi-hop questions; submit_answer triggers synthesis.

nodes.label: /selfrag reflective synthesis
nodes.rationale: ReAct outside + reflective draft with [NEED]/[SUPPORTED]/[UNCERTAIN] markers, re-retrieving on [NEED] up to max_refinements; costs ~2x /agent latency, used when per-claim citations/verifiability are required.

nodes.label: Per-request tracing (trace_request)
nodes.rationale: ContextVar-scoped trace_request context-manager records tool_call/llm_call/refinement_round events so concurrent requests don't cross-contaminate.

nodes.label: Eval gate (287 tests + golden Q&A)
nodes.rationale: 287 tests plus identifier_recall (7 golden cases, thresholds) and deterministic answer_quality grader; treated as the acceptance contract with the customer, computed per PR.

nodes.label: Postgres job-state store
nodes.rationale: documents job-status table (uuid -> status -> path); no ORM.

nodes.label: RabbitMQ / taskiq broker
nodes.rationale: taskiq broker with the process_document queue for async ingest, retries and backpressure.

nodes.label: LiteLLM proxy (LLM/embed gateway)
nodes.rationale: Single stateless gateway to LLM + embeddings (Ollama/OpenAI); enables reversible on-prem model swap without code change.

nodes.label: Conference deck D (internal defense)
nodes.rationale: Internal project-defense deck with speaker notes; frames eval-gate as the customer contract and on-prem-first as a deliberate choice.

nodes.label: Conscious out-of-scope decisions
nodes.rationale: Deliberate 'no's: multi-tenant isolation (department in metadata but no retrieve enforcement), streaming/SSE, BM25+RRF hybrid (module exists, not wired to DI), periodic graph dedup, document-level summaries, agent tool-result caching. Framed as an artifact as important as the roadmap.

nodes.label: R1-R10 roadmap / status
nodes.rationale: 9-stage prototype + R1-R10 refactor treated as one track, not two projects. R1 qwen3:8b done; R5-R6 (287 tests + docs) done; R7-R8 ReAct+reflective done; R9 answer-quality eval in progress; R10 (decommission legacy) gated by R9. Open risks: incremental ER race, phantom phone-chunks, claim-level citations.

nodes.label: Runbook index
nodes.rationale: Operator runbook catalog; each file self-contained. Also lists architectural docs (ARCHITECTURE/MODELS/DEPLOYMENT/SEARCH/ANALYTICS-GUIDE) and update rules.

nodes.label: Admission control (IngestSchedulerWorkflow)
nodes.rationale: Optional document-level concurrency cap: a singleton IngestSchedulerWorkflow (signal-with-start, USE_EXISTING) admits <=K documents inflight FIFO so a document is driven to completion as a priority unit instead of its merge tail starving behind newer extracts. K=1 strictest but idles GPU; 2-3 balances GPU. Live K change via scripts.set_admission; Temporal shell not yet exercised on live-Temporal.

nodes.label: ingest_metrics (Postgres per-run timings)
nodes.rationale: finalize parses each workflow's history into one Postgres row per (activity,attempt) with a version_tag and per-activity model. Best-effort (failure doesn't fail the workflow); the only source for long-term comparisons (retained forever vs Prom 30d / Temporal history 24h). Env var is ANALYTICS_DEFAULT_VERSION_TAG (not ANALYTICS_VERSION_TAG).

nodes.label: Prometheus + Grafana ingest analytics
nodes.rationale: Two independent, duplicating paths: live aggregated Prometheus (worker exporter scraped every 15s) and frozen per-run Postgres. Grafana serves Overview / Version-compare / Run drill-down dashboards, auto-provisioned.

nodes.label: Input document classifier (classify_document)
nodes.rationale: Optional opt-in filter between fetch_source and parse_and_chunk that drops junk before it costs parse/embed/extract: force bypass -> deterministic rules -> optional LLM gate. Fail-soft: any classifier error -> ingest, since a false skip loses a good document (aim for high recall on 'keep'). Skip -> terminal 'skipped' status + reason. Flag snapshotted into IngestParams for Temporal determinism.

nodes.label: doc_id backfill for legacy Milvus chunks
nodes.rationale: scripts/backfill_doc_id.py stamps doc_id onto pre-existing Milvus chunks (from documents.file_path->doc_id) by reconstructing the node and restoring text+embedding (no re-embed/re-parse), idempotent. Chunks whose file_path is absent from Postgres stay unresolved. Live Milvus I/O path not exercised in-env; dry-run first.
nodes.norm_label: doc_id backfill for legacy milvus chunks

nodes.label: Native vector kNN ER (er_vec)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the ER_INCREMENTAL_WINDOW (5000) load with native Neo4j vector kNN over er_vec across the whole graph (recall ~96% at ~6ms vs ~2% at 200k). Strict order: backfill er_vec+index first, then set AGENT_ER_USE_NATIVE_VECTOR_KNN; enabling before backfill degrades to within-batch ER. Needs Neo4j 5.x vector index + APOC; dim from MILVUS_DIM.

nodes.label: Graph analytics layer (plan->compute->synthesize, 42 primitives)
nodes.rationale: Answers quantitative/structural graph questions via LLM plan -> deterministic Cypher primitives (compute) -> LLM synthesize, run as AnalyticalQueryWorkflow on the search pool. Provenance rule: numbers come from provenance.steps[].rows (source of truth); answer is a gloss (small models miswrite figures). ANALYTICS_MAX_STEPS default 3.

nodes.label: Analytics materialization (AnalyticsMaterializeWorkflow)
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget offline job on the graph_build queue precomputes GDS pagerank/betweenness/eigenvector + link-prediction + risk back into Neo4j; run after each bulk ingest and after reresolve_graph, else centrality/forecasts reflect the old graph.

nodes.label: Monitoring Arc-2
nodes.rationale: Opt-in periodic Temporal-Schedule sweep (monitor pool) detecting new relations, risk rises and event bursts; alerts stored in graph (read by alerts/review_queue primitives) and optionally pushed to a webhook. MONITOR_* must be added to the compose x-app-env anchor or env won't reach the container (same trap as the TEMPORAL_COMMUNITY_BACKEND incident).

nodes.label: Hermes Agent integration
nodes.rationale: Connects kb-llamaindex to Nous Research Hermes Agent as a tool source over MCP/SSE; memory and dialog loop live on Hermes. Additive (MCP behavior unchanged). Auth via FastMCP StaticTokenVerifier (plaintext tokens = API_KEYS in process memory) -> keep SSE ports internal / TLS reverse-proxy; switch to JWTVerifier for token lifetime/scopes.

nodes.label: Leiden community-detection diagnostics
nodes.rationale: 0 communities on a graph with entities is almost always a sparse/disconnected __Entity__ subgraph (singletons dropped by community_min_size), not a Leiden perf limit. fail-soft logs distinguish GDS fault vs empty projection vs all-singletons. Leiden runs weighted on r.weight, randomSeed 19 for determinism; resolution via TEMPORAL_COMMUNITY_LEIDEN_GAMMA.

nodes.label: MCP-1 search server (5 tools via Temporal)
nodes.rationale: src/mcp/search_server.py exposes kb_search/kb_global_search/kb_drift_search/kb_auto_search/kb_analyze, submitting Temporal workflows on the search queue for 'get a finished answer'. Post-R7b kb_search submits SearchOrchestratorWorkflow (local plan-execute); old mode/max_iterations params and simple/agent/selfrag are removed. GPU protected by the Temporal queue cap.
nodes.norm_label: mcp-1 search server (5 tools via temporal)

nodes.label: MCP-2 atomic tools server
nodes.rationale: src/mcp/tools_server.py exposes atomic retrieval + read-only GDS tools as direct in-process Python (no Temporal) for clients running their own LLM loop; 'take primitives and build your own loop'. filter_by_metadata deliberately not exposed (stateful accumulator meaningless across a stateless MCP boundary).

nodes.label: BoundedLLM GPU semaphore
nodes.rationale: Shared-process semaphore wrapping search-role LLM so parallel LLM-using tools queue behind a concurrency cap; the second layer of GPU protection alongside the Temporal queue for MCP-1.

nodes.label: atomic_tools.py (pure retrieval functions)
nodes.rationale: Pure retrieval functions (vector_search BM25+dense+RRF, graph_search, find_entity_by_id, find_neighbours, get_chunks_by_doc_id, read_full_document) wrapped thinly by MCP-2; pure IO tools run parallel, LLM-using ones gate through the semaphore.

nodes.label: LLMPool (per-process concurrency owner)
nodes.rationale: One-per-process owner of LLM concurrency with two gates acquired lane-first->tier-global: tier-ceiling (small=real GPU capacity 25, large=API budget 8) and per-role lane caps (over-subscribing the tier so one role can fill the GPU but not exceed its lane). JUDGE_FLOOR reserves capacity for merge/judge. Supersedes the dead AGENT_LLM_MAX_CONCURRENT; Temporal caps are now isolation-only and set >= lane caps so the pool binds first.

nodes.label: Per-role/tier LLM selection
nodes.rationale: Seven roles (extraction/judge/search/route/plan/retrieve/synthesis) map to a tier (small/large) -> one of two physical models (LITELLM_MODEL_SMALL/LARGE); default all small except synthesis=large. Per-role model is snapshotted at /ingest submit so env changes only affect new documents (by design). Replaced old per-role *_MODEL env vars.

nodes.label: DocumentIngestWorkflow (parent)
nodes.rationale: Parent flow (id ingest-{doc_id}, queue kb-ingest): fetch_source, parse_and_chunk, index_vector, inject_canonical, extract_kg, then awaits the GraphBuildWorkflow child, push_wikibase, finalize. Catches (ActivityError, ChildWorkflowError) to downgrade to vector_only.

nodes.label: GraphBuildWorkflow (child)
nodes.rationale: Child workflow (id graph-{doc_id}, queue kb-ingest-llm) holding merge_and_resolve + build_property_graph. Three wins: independent retry/timeout (stuck merge doesn't fail ingest), separate Temporal-UI visibility, and a clean vector_only fallback when it errors. Its event history is fetched best-effort by finalize and merged with the parent's for ingest_metrics.

nodes.label: vector_only fallback
nodes.rationale: When the graph child fails (LLM down, ER timeout, Neo4j unreachable) the parent marks graph_status=vector_only: the document stays searchable by vector, the KG isn't built, push_wikibase is skipped, and the child history simply doesn't exist for metrics.

nodes.label: Manual reingest + low-priority RabbitMQ lane
nodes.rationale: tg_ingest --reingest posts newest N channel messages at RabbitMQ priority 0 (PRIO_BACKFILL) vs live priority 5, so backfill only takes a free slot when no live message is ready. Requires a one-time delete+redeclare of ingest.pending to add x-max-priority (queue args are immutable); pre-migration failure is loud (500s + consumer crash-loop), not silent. Priority governs the next free slot, not preemption.

nodes.label: Batch graph consolidation (reresolve_graph)
nodes.rationale: scripts/reresolve_graph.py runs ER across the WHOLE graph to merge semantic duplicates accumulated across independent ingests (incremental ER only compares the new batch to stored canonicals). Reuses resolve_entities as a pure decision fn via a read-only graph proxy; merges applied only with --no-dry-run via _cleanup_stored_losers, preserving relation types (WORKS_AT stays WORKS_AT) unlike the identifier-merge script. Dominant cost: re-embedding every entity.

nodes.label: Search modes /search/{local,global,drift,auto}
nodes.rationale: Post-R7b surface: local (plan->parallel retrieve->coverage-gate->rerank->synthesis, default), global (map-reduce over community summaries, needs rebuild), drift (local->global expansion), auto (route_query classifies, fail-safe to local). Body fields beyond query/top_k/history are accepted but ignored. Graph depth/hops are config (AGENT_GRAPH_SEARCH_PATH_DEPTH), not request fields. All AGENT_/TEMPORAL_/LITELLM_/HF_ read at submit/worker-start -> restart API+worker after .env edits.

nodes.label: Community rebuild trigger (/admin/communities/rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Offline admin trigger that builds graph communities (minutes) that global/drift search depend on for freshness/quality; distinct from the wiki-rebuild trigger.

nodes.label: Source download endpoint (GET /api/v1/documents/{doc_id})
nodes.rationale: Streams the original file from MinIO (URI from documents.path) with Content-Disposition attachment + RFC 6266 filename*; legacy local-path docs served from disk. Each sources[]/documents[] doc_id maps to a relative download url.

nodes.label: Continuous wiki editor (WikiSweepWorkflow)
nodes.rationale: Turns Neo4j entities into per-entity MediaWiki articles; unit of work is one entity, triggered by ingest marking wiki_dirty + a Temporal Schedule (or manual /admin/wiki/rebuild) draining the dirty queue. Rewrites only the bot section between KB-BOT markers; human text preserved. Anti-drift architecturally: only graph+citations feed the prompt, prior prose never fed back. Hash-skip avoids MediaWiki calls when the entity subgraph is unchanged.

nodes.label: Wikibase populator (push_wikibase)
nodes.rationale: Structural push of Items/Properties to Wikibase; it is what creates wikibase_qid used for the wiki-editor sitelink. Shares WIKIBASE_BOT_USER/PASSWORD with the wiki editor.

nodes.label: Self-hosted Wikibase
nodes.rationale: Second queryable source of truth alongside Neo4j so non-RAG teams get a schema-rich store (REST + WDQS SPARQL) without Neo4j access

nodes.label: WDQS / Blazegraph SPARQL endpoint
nodes.rationale: Eventually-consistent SPARQL traversal over the whole instance; REST wbgetentities is authoritative under sync lag

nodes.label: scripts/setup_wikibase.py bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Idempotent: 10 base-class Items + 27 Properties, provisions KbBot via createAndPromote --bot --force, caches QIDs/PIDs into Neo4j

nodes.label: QID writeback idempotency
nodes.rationale: wikibase_qid stored on :__Entity__ so re-ingest takes update path; created_items>0 on re-ingest signals writeback failure

nodes.label: Claims/covariates extraction (KG_CLAIMS_KEY)
nodes.rationale: GraphRAG-style typed claims on entities for B2B/support facts; load-bearing for deferred Project B (doc-type/authority/fact conflicts)

nodes.label: AgentSettings config class
nodes.rationale: Read in ~28 sites; llm_max_concurrent + observation_max_chars are dead; name is vestige of old agent framing

nodes.label: Cypher→nGQL MATCH translation rules
nodes.rationale: Tag-qualified props, r.rel_type over type(r), aliased ORDER BY only, INLINE nGQL via _q()/entity_vid; live-verified on kb space

nodes.label: NebulaGraph backend
nodes.rationale: GRAPH_BACKEND default flipped neo4j→nebula 2026-07-11; sole runtime graph backend; fresh graph via re-ingest (no backfill)

nodes.label: Neo4j graph backend (retained seam)
nodes.rationale: Neo4j seam code retained inert for rollback (GRAPH_BACKEND=neo4j) until prod re-ingest validates nebula end-to-end

nodes.label: Wiki-editor crash set under nebula
nodes.rationale: Only subsystem that CRASHES (not degrades) under nebula — raw Cypher with no fail-soft in wiki_dirty/wiki_context/wiki_sweep

nodes.label: Neo4j→nebula data-migration blocker
nodes.rationale: No backfill/dual-write tooling; options are full-node exporter backfill or re-ingest; billion-scale needs bulk-import

nodes.label: Marp Markdown decks (A/D)
nodes.rationale: Two decks built with @marp-team/marp-cli via npx; A=22 slides tech conf, D=23 slides internal defense with speaker notes

nodes.label: Three search endpoints (/search /agent /selfrag)
nodes.rationale: One query→three answers trading latency vs reasoning vs verifiability; /search 1 LLM call, /agent ReAct, /selfrag reflective

nodes.label: Entity Resolution 12-step pipeline
nodes.rationale: Conservative default DIFFERENT on timeout; skips 12 identifier types; cross-script always LLM; hyper-hub clamp; better a duplicate than a false merge

nodes.label: LightRAG-style KG extractor
nodes.rationale: One LLM call per chunk yields entities+relations; replaced SchemaLLMPathExtractor that failed on small LLMs; RU B2B few-shot

nodes.label: Milvus vector index
nodes.rationale: Stores chunk vectors + original-language text; drop-collection wipe target; MILVUS_DIM must match embed model

nodes.label: LiteLLM proxy gateway
nodes.rationale: Single stateless gateway to LLM+embeddings (Ollama/OpenAI); reversible swap without code change

nodes.label: ReAct agent (/agent, react_agent.py)

nodes.rationale: One small-LLM activity rewrites the follow-up into a standalone question; params.model_copy(query=rewritten) so the whole downstream pipeline is unchanged. Empty history/flag off/LLM error → untouched (fail-open).

nodes.rationale: Three cheap orthogonal improvements from the 250k-entity scaling review.

nodes.label: Drift graceful fallback to local answer

nodes.label: Structured community reports (report_vec, incremental)
nodes.rationale: Reports (title/summary/findings) generated bottom-up, carried over when members_hash unchanged, embedded into a community_report_vec index.

nodes.label: Dynamic community selection (semantic kNN v1 + descent v2)
nodes.rationale: Global/drift select communities by semantic kNN (v1) and top-down descent (v2); lexical path kept as fail-open fallback; opt-in via config enum.
nodes.norm_label: dynamic community selection (semantic knn v1 + descent v2)

nodes.label: K+N throttle migration plan
nodes.rationale: Make K+N the only concurrency model and delete the per-role hierarchical throttle.

nodes.rationale: One global Semaphore(N) (LLM_POOL_N) gates every LLM call; role still selects the physical model but no longer affects gating; closes the leak where 4 search activities bypassed the pool.

nodes.label: Always-on ingest admission (IngestSchedulerWorkflow)
nodes.rationale: /ingest hands every document to a singleton scheduler running at most K (max_inflight) documents at once, FIFO, so a document's merge tail isn't starved behind newer extract bursts.

nodes.rationale: Seven parallel TDD tracks, one feature branch each.

nodes.rationale: classify_document activity (rules + LLM gate) short-circuits junk to skipped; force=true bypasses rules.
